schema.hex: Lowercase contiguous octets; empty means no bytes. output_hex is normative only for pinned authority. Ambiguity rows keep null and use policy_output_hex for the selected interpretation. Policy/integration rows are design expectations, never runtime/native proof.
schema.typed_inputs: event/native_record/api_call represent non-byte input. Empty input_hex on these rows means no wire bytes at that boundary; not missing capture masquerading as proof. Native record memory/wire layout not invented.
schema.event: key is numeric Unicode scalar or functional name; modifiers is actual bitmask (wire field is+1); event_type is protocol1/2/3, not proof OS supplied physical action; key0 is text-only when provenance lacks key
schema.state: pane states have independent main/alternate arrays ordered oldest to active top, with absent top effective0. A-STACK representation proposed. Client states and pane states use separate row shapes; repeated timer is not protocol repeat.
schema.event_reencode: synthetic acquired outer bytes -> normalized event -> application bytes at initial pane flags; does not attest any real terminal capability
schema.output_scope: target names boundary; decoder rows output no wire bytes and event/events contain expected decoded values; route/neighbor rows may have only keyboard output expectations. Additional control side effects explicitly noted.
schema.serialization: one preferred valid spelling, optional omission variants covered; no assertion that all other permitted spellings fail
